title: 第1191章 没有选择只能赌第1190章 叶倾仙难以接受
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
死一般的沉默之中。
她明亮的眼眸一下子就黯淡了下去。
叶倾仙怎么也没想到这一天会来的这么快。
虽然知道叶家迟早会站队。
但是在她的考量之中，其实这个选择远没有这么容易做出来。
而这些天的接触，她心中的天秤也开始偏向了某人。
甚至心中已经多了某个混蛋的影子。
叶玄看着女儿如此悲伤。
他也是心如刀割。
但是手心手背都是肉，他没办法。
他是镇妖殿的殿主，是叶家的主心骨。
镇压妖域，造下了滔天的无边杀戮，即使是伏尸亿万，血海滔天。
他都不会皱一下眉头。
但是现在，他也难断家务事！
一边是自己的两位儿子，一边是自己的女儿。
看着闺女那苍白的脸色。
他甚至在想，要不就算了吧。
叶玄微微闭着眼睛。
他这一生，经历了无数艰难的时刻。
甚至不知道多少次生死一线。

但是即使是在最艰难的时候，也没有现在这样让他心痛。
而他甚至知道，女儿或许会做出某种选择。
虽然他早已经做出了布置。
但是依然是心如刀绞。
“哥哥他们....真的可以复生么？”
叶倾仙语气轻轻的问道。
她看向父亲。
此时此刻，她自己也不知道自己应该做出什么选择。
一边是自己的两位兄长亲哥哥。
一边是自己刚刚认识的如意郎君，这个选择，似乎是很好做出来才是。
毕竟那是外人。
毕竟她还没有以身相许。
但是为什么她的心这么痛呢。
叶倾仙咬着嘴唇，一缕缕血迹渗出。
看着亲闺女，叶玄有些艰难的点了点头。
“概率很大，所以我没办法视而不见。”
叶倾仙站了起来。
“我知道了。”
她有些踉踉跄跄的往外走。
但是很快，她就站直了身子，她是仙皇，她是镇妖殿的少殿主！

她也是两位哥哥的亲妹妹。
“一切全凭父亲大人的决议。”
“还请父亲放心。”
“倾仙不会做出不理智的事情。”
content_en:
In deathly silence.
Her bright eyes suddenly dimmed.
Ye Qingxian never expected that this day would come so quickly.
Although I know that the Ye family will take sides sooner or later.
But in her consideration, this choice was actually far from easy to make.
And after these days of contact, the scale in her heart began to tilt towards someone.
There is even a shadow of a certain bastard in his heart.
Ye Xuan looked at his daughter so sad.
He was also heartbroken.
But the palms and backs of his hands were all flesh, and he couldn't do anything about it.
He is the master of the Demon Suppression Hall and the backbone of the Ye family.
Suppressing the Demon Realm resulted in a monstrous and boundless killing, even if there were hundreds of millions of corpses lying on the ground, and the sea of ​​blood was monstrous.
He won't even frown.
But now, it’s hard for him to stop doing housework!
On one side are his two sons and on the other side is his daughter.
Look at the pale face of my daughter.
He was even thinking about forgetting it.
Ye Xuan closed his eyes slightly.
He has experienced countless difficult moments in his life.
I don’t even know how many times life and death have been on the line.
But even in the toughest times, it never pained him as much as it does now.
And he even knew that his daughter might make some kind of choice.
Although he had already made arrangements.
But still heartbroken.
"Brother, can they...really be resurrected?"
Ye Qingxian asked softly.
She looked at her father.
At this moment, she herself didn't know what choice she should make.
On one side are his two elder brothers.
On one side is the husband he just met. This choice seems to be easy to make.
After all, they are outsiders.
After all, she hasn't committed herself to him yet.
But why does her heart hurt so much.
Ye Qingxian bit her lip, and wisps of blood seeped out.
Looking at his daughter, Ye Xuan nodded with some difficulty.
"The probability is very high, so I can't turn a blind eye."
Ye Qingxian stood up.
"I understand."
She staggered out a little.
But soon, she stood up straight. She was the Immortal Emperor, and she was the young master of the Demon Suppression Palace!
She is also the biological sister of two brothers.
"Everything depends on father's decision."
"Father, please rest assured."
"Qingxian will not do anything irrational."
